notes: Revenue, operating income and player expenses are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season; valuation is Forbes March 2026. ownership_summary: Owned by an investment group led by Bill DeWitt Jr., which bought the club from Anheuser-Busch in 1996; the DeWitt family holds the controlling interest. In June 2026 DeWitt Jr. stayed principal owner and chairman and his son Bill DeWitt III became CEO. No private equity or other fund holder is on record.
